thingsToDo.title: Visit River Fox Train
thingsToDo.description: River Fox Train is a district in Sacramento, California. River Fox Train is a recognized destination connected to tours operating in Sacramento, California, and appears frequently in local itineraries for its sightseeing value and geographic setting. The site helps explain how Sacramento developed through its environment, civic planning, or cultural institutions, so visitors get a grounded understanding of the destination.

thingsToDo.title: Visit California State Capitol Museum
thingsToDo.description: California State Capitol Museum is a park in Sacramento, California. California State Capitol Museum combines government history with a beautifully landscaped park in the heart of Sacramento. The museum tours showcase restored chambers and historic exhibits, while the surrounding grounds are ideal for a stroll. It is a signature stop for understanding the city’s political heritage.

thingsToDo.title: Visit Old Sacramento Waterfront
thingsToDo.description: Old Sacramento Waterfront is a district in Sacramento, California. Old Sacramento Waterfront features Gold Rush-era buildings, wooden sidewalks, and riverfront views along the Sacramento River. The district is walkable and packed with museums, shops, and riverfront cafés. It is an easy place to spend an afternoon soaking in the city’s history.

thingsToDo.title: Visit Crocker Art Museum
thingsToDo.description: Crocker Art Museum is a cultural attraction in Sacramento, California. Crocker Art Museum is California’s oldest art museum, featuring a mix of European, American, and California-focused collections. The historic mansion wing and modern galleries create a unique architectural contrast. It is a strong cultural stop in downtown Sacramento.

thingsToDo.title: Visit Sutter's Fort State Historic Park
thingsToDo.description: Sutter's Fort State Historic Park is a park in Sacramento, California. Sutter's Fort State Historic Park preserves a key site from California’s early settlement era, with reconstructed adobe walls and hands-on exhibits. The fort gives context to Sacramento’s Gold Rush history and is easy to explore in a short visit. It is a compact but meaningful stop for history lovers.

thingsToDo.title: Visit Sacramento Zoo
thingsToDo.description: Sacramento Zoo is a historic site in Sacramento, California. Sacramento Zoo is a family-friendly attraction with a walkable layout and a focus on conservation education. The zoo’s shaded paths make it comfortable in warmer months, and the exhibits are easy to see without a full-day commitment. It is a reliable stop for families visiting the city.
